blocks.text: Fossil record (zameen mein mehfooz purane nishanaat) batata hai ke prokaryotes, yani archaea aur bacteria, 3.5 arab (billion) saal pehle bohat ziyada tadaad mein the. Yeh evolve hote (badalte) rahe aur agle 2 arab saal tak zameen par bilkul akele rahe. Aaj prokaryotes (archaea aur bacteria) har us jagah milte hain jahan zindagi hai. Bacteria pani, hawa, mitti, khaane aur janwaron aur podon ke jismon mein milte hain. In ki tadaad tamam eukaryotes se zyada hai. Yeh extreme (intehai sakht) jagahon par bhi zinda reh sakte hain.
Bacteria mein diversity (qisam qisam ke bacteria) aur un ki ecology

Margulis aur Schwartz ne tamam prokaryotes ke liye ek mufeed classification system pesh kiya. Unhon ne inhen 16 phyla mein baanta. Neeche domain Bacteria ke ahem groups bayan kiye gaye hain (Figure 2.9).

blocks.title: Dilchasp baat
blocks.text: Shayad sab se dilchasp baat yeh haal ki daryaft (discovery) hai ke hamare aaj ke petroleum ke zakheeray (deposits) ka bara hissa gale sare (decayed) cyanobacteria ke dheron se bana.

items: Omnibacteria: Yeh sakht (rigid), rod jaise, heterotrophic (doosron se khoraak lene wale), Gram-negative bacteria hain. Bohat se ahem pathogens (bimari phailane wale) isi group mein hain. In mein se aksar mein flagella hote hain. Yeh spores nahin banate. Yeh aam tor par aerobic (oxygen istemal karne wale) hote hain. Escherichia coli is ki misal hai. Is group mein vibrios bhi shamil hain.

Cyanobacteria: Yeh photosynthetic (roshni se khoraak banane wale) bacteria hain. Zameen ki tareekh mein fiza (atmosphere) mein azaad oxygen barhane mein inhon ne sab se ahem kirdar ada kiya. In mein chlorophyll-a aur madadgar (accessory) pigments hote hain, jaise carotenoids aur neele aur laal phycobilins. Bohat se cyanobacteria apne khaas cells, heterocysts, mein hawa ki nitrogen fix karte hain. Yeh mitti mein mats (tehon) ki shakal mein aam milte hain. Cyanobacteria wale lichens chattanon ki satah par milte hain. Samundar ki teh ki mitti (sediments) par mats mein zyadatar cyanobacteria hote hain.

Mycoplasmas aur Spiroplasmas: Yeh groups baqi tamam bacteria se is baat mein mukhtalif hain ke in mein cell wall nahin hoti. Cell wall na hone ki wajah se penicillin aur woh doosri antibiotics in par asar nahin kartin jo cell wall ki growth rok kar kaam karti hain. Kuch mycoplasmas mammals mein bimariyan karte hain, jaise insanon mein kuch qisam ka pneumonia. Spiroplasmas podon ki ahem bimariyan karte hain, jaise nariyal (coconut) ki lethal yellowing disease.

Spirochaetes: Yeh lambe spirilla hain jin ki cell wall Gram-negative hoti hai. In mein 2 se le kar 100 se zyada flagella ho sakte hain. Treponema ahem spirochaetes hain. Yeh syphilis karte hain (jinsi talluq se phailne wali ek jaan-leva bimari).

Pseudomonads: Yeh seedhe ya mure hue Gram-negative rods hain jin ke ek sire par ek ya kai flagella hote hain. Yeh mitti aur pani mein milte hain. Yeh organic compounds ko aasani se tor dete hain. Kuch autotrophic (apni khoraak khud banane wale) hain lekin bohat se podon ke pathogens hain. Kuch denitrification (nitrate ko wapas nitrogen gas banana) mein kirdar ada karte hain. Pseudomonas aeruginosa mitti, pani aur kachi sabziyon mein milta hai. Yeh aam tor par be-zarar (harmless) hai, lekin kamzor logon mein sanjeeda infections kar sakta hai.

Actinomycetes: In ki growth dhaagon jaisi (filamentous) hoti hai. Yeh aise spores banate hain jo na-mawafiq halaat bardasht kar lete hain. Kuch actinomycetes nitrogen fix karte hain aur bohat se phooldar podon ki root nodules (jaron ki gaanthon) mein milte hain. Kuch actinomycetes dental plaque ke zimmedar hain, jis mein daanton ka enamel (upar ki sakht teh) kharab ho jata hai. Is group ka ek member, Mycobacterium leprae, leprosy (korh) karta hai. Doosra member, Mycobacterium tuberculosis, tuberculosis (TB) ki wajah hai. Bohat si antibiotics, jaise tetracycline, chloramphenicol, erythromycin aur neomycin, shuru mein actinomycetes se hi hasil ki gayi theen.

Nitrogen fix karne wale aerobic bacteria: Is group mein maashi (economic) tor par ahem bacteria hain. Yeh Gram-negative hain aur aksar mein flagella hote hain. Azotobacter is group ka member hai. Yeh mitti aur pani mein milta hai aur hawa ki nitrogen ko fix kar ke ammonia (NH₃) banata hai.

Chemosynthetic bacteria: Yeh bacteria nitrogen, sulphur aur iron ke inorganic (be-jaan maddon wale) compounds ki oxidation se energy hasil karte hain. Is energy se woh apni khoraak banate hain. Nitrosomonas aur Nitrobacter isi group mein hain. Yeh nitrogen compounds (NH₃) ko oxidise kar ke energy lete hain. NH₃ pehle nitrite aur phir nitrate mein badalti hai. Is tarah yeh nitrogen cycle mein bohat ahem kirdar ada karte hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab point 7 mein likhti hai ke Azotobacter hawa ki nitrogen ko “nitrates” mein badalta hai. Asal mein nitrogen fixation se ammonia (NH₃) banti hai, nitrate nahin. Ammonia ko nitrite aur phir nitrate mein nitrifying bacteria (Nitrosomonas aur Nitrobacter, point 8) badalte hain.

blocks.title: Dilchasp baat
blocks.text: Gande (polluted) pani mein cyanobacteria ki be-hisaab growth se rangeen blooms (pani par rang ki tehen) ban sakte hain. In blooms ke rang cyanobacteria ke photosynthetic pigments ki wajah se hote hain.

blocks.title: Dilchasp baat
blocks.text: Har saal actinomycetes se taqreeban 150 nayi antibiotics daryaft ho rahi hain.

blocks.title: Table parhne ka tareeqa
blocks.text: Kitab ki table huroof (letters) istemal karti hai. Shakal: R = rods (bacilli), C = cocci, S = spirilla, M = baqaida chains ya guchhe. Harkat: F = flagella wale, N = non-motile (harkat nahin karte), G = gliding. Khoraak: H = heterotrophic, C = chemosynthetic, P = photosynthetic. Kitab ki Figure 2.9 mein in groups ki misalon ki tasweerein hain: Escherichia coli, Anabaena, Mycoplasmas, Treponema, Pseudomonas, Mycobacterium tuberculosis, Azotobacter aur Nitrosomonas.

blocks.prompt: Kaunse group mein cell wall nahin hoti, aur is wajah se penicillin us par asar kyun nahin karti?
blocks.explanation: Mycoplasmas aur spiroplasmas mein cell wall nahin hoti. Penicillin aur us jaisi antibiotics cell wall ki growth rok kar kaam karti hain; jab cell wall hai hi nahin to un ka koi nishana nahin, is liye asar nahin hota.

items: Prokaryotes 3.5 arab saal pehle bohat zyada the aur 2 arab saal zameen par akele rahe; bacteria aaj har jagah hain jahan zindagi hai aur tadaad mein tamam eukaryotes se zyada hain.

Margulis aur Schwartz ne prokaryotes ko 16 phyla mein rakha; kitab ke 8 groups: omnibacteria, cyanobacteria, mycoplasmas aur spiroplasmas, spirochaetes, pseudomonads, actinomycetes, nitrogen fix karne wale aerobic bacteria aur chemosynthetic bacteria.

Cyanobacteria ne zameen ki azaad oxygen barhayi aur heterocysts mein nitrogen fix karte hain; actinomycetes se bohat si antibiotics mileen; Azotobacter nitrogen fix karta hai, aur Nitrosomonas aur Nitrobacter ammonia ko nitrite aur nitrate banate hain.
